# Modesto v1.0.0-alpha.1 RC

**Status: release candidate.** Semver is `1.0.0-alpha.1`. This is the first public 1.0-line build, **not** a finished 1.0 product.

Modesto is a local-first desktop control plane for the coding agents you already pay for. It does not resell tokens. Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok, Meta Muse Code, Factory Droid, Kilo Code, OpenCode, Pi, GitHub Copilot (opt-in), and other compatible CLIs share one workspace: **Code** for shipping software, **Work** for local cowork.

Source for this candidate: this repository. License: **AGPL-3.0-only**.

## What “RC” means here

- Far enough along to use and review.
- Surfaces, reliability, and packaging are still moving.
- **Signed installers are not published yet.** GitHub Latest remains the last shipped desktop build (`v0.3.0`) until notarized macOS, Authenticode Windows, and updater manifests land.
- Do not treat this tag as a production 1.0 announcement.

## What’s new in this candidate

### Workspace

- **Chats without a project** in Code: start and send with no folder open. Work still requires a project.
- **Code and Work** share sidebar and composer chrome; only the job of each workspace changes.
- **Desktop environments:** local host, optional WSL and SSH. Threads bind to an environment.
- **Pop-out chat:** always-on-top window for the current thread (desktop).
- **Header usage clock:** 5-hour and weekly provider limits for the selected model. Modesto does not sell quota.

### Agents and providers

- Runtime-discovered providers; new CLIs show up without a hardcoded list.
- **Grok** and **Meta Muse Code** (`muse` / `muse --acp` / Muse Spark) are first-class and on by default.
- **GitHub Copilot CLI** is opt-in (`copilot --acp`).
- Mid-thread **handoff** starts a fresh session on the new provider and replays prior context.
- Isolated Git worktrees per thread, inline diffs, approvals, terminals, and browser previews.

### Chat and Connections

- Inline **Mermaid**, SVG graphs, and interactive HTML previews (Preview / Source / restart). Generated pages run in an isolated frame after the stream finishes.
- **Connections** for daily apps and MCP servers (Figma, Framer, Higgsfield, Canva, Supabase, and others). Install commands copy into chat. Brand marks are third-party — see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/Syphon1205/Modesto/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
- Right-panel **Music** (Apple Music on Mac; Spotify and others in the in-app browser).
- Agent character presets, avatar customization, clearer task-dispatch errors.
- Expired local **MCP** credentials recover on the next turn; auth settings survive edits to an existing connection.

### Platform and license

- Client-server core: typed RPC, Effect services, Git through the real `gh` CLI.
- Secret scanning and ignore rules so local homes, `.env`, signing keys, and generated installers stay out of the public snapshot.
- Relabeled **AGPL-3.0-only** (MIT through v0.3.x) because of the Bible Strong avatar engine.

## Planned desktop matrix (when signed)

| Platform | Artifact |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-arm64.dmg` (+ updater ZIP) |
| macOS Intel | `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x64.dmg` |
| Windows x64 | `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x64.exe` (publisher **Modesto Team**) |
| Linux x64 | `Modesto-1.0.0-alpha.1-x86_64.AppImage` |

No iOS package and no ISO image in this matrix. After signed builds pass, the release publishes `latest*.yml` and `modesto*.yml` so older GitHub installs can update in-app. Until then, existing apps stay on the last published release.

## Known issues and gaps

**Packaging**

- This draft may include checksums or **unsigned validation** packages only. macOS may be ad-hoc signed and **not notarized**. Windows may have **no Authenticode signature** (SmartScreen / Unknown Publisher even when company metadata says Modesto Team). Linux AppImages are unsigned.
- Do not present validation artifacts as a signed production release. Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you sideload a validation build.
- Public CI/release workflow files are not on the public snapshot yet.

**Install and update**

- In-app updater will not hop to 1.0 until this tag is published as GitHub Latest with manifests. `/releases/latest` currently points at `v0.3.0`.
- First-run copies legacy `~/.modesto` / Electron profiles once; it never deletes the old copy.

**Product**

- **Work** is early cowork, not a finished 1.0 surface.
- Projectless send is **Code only**.
- Native macOS extras (menus, pickers, deep links) are planned; the main workspace stays web-in-Electron.
- One HTTP snapshot transfer-budget test is still above its target; WebSocket budgets pass. Full interactive smoke on every OS is still pending.
- Set the GitHub **About** license to AGPL-3.0 so the download API does not keep showing MIT.

**Expectations**

- Recovering from session restarts, reconnects, and partial streams is still being hardened. Once a signed RC is installed, report bugs against this candidate, not an older desktop.

## How to try it now

1. Clone this repo (`bun install`, `bun run modesto:dev`).
2. Requirements: Bun 1.3.9+, Node.js 24.13.1+, at least one provider CLI.
3. Watch this Releases page for the signed RC. Until then, keep the last published installer if you need a notarized app.
